notes: SNES PLAYER_NAME commands are represented explicitly as Android-style %S(index,0) placeholders for comparison only.
Android anchor intervals include following English-empty localization slots.
Very-high-confidence SNES-to-Android-English identity is not rejected merely because French wording is freely adapted.
When French or Android segmentation crosses individual anchors, preserve and review the complete local sequence block rather than forcing a per-ID translation.

scenes.label: Gnome joins the party after Tropicallo

units.source_display:
GNOME:Phew! Thanks! That
 oaf was ALWAYS bugging me.
units.android_english_display:
Gnome: Phew! Thanks! That oaf was
ALWAYS bugging me.
units.french_display: Gnome : Oh, merci ! Vous êtes forts ! Il me persécutait, vous savez !
units.note: Distinct Gnome introduction; exact ordered local anchor.

units.source_display:
Forgive me. I used you to
 get some relief.
units.android_english_display: Forgive me. I used you to get some relief.
units.french_display: Et je me suis mis à me comporter comme lui... Pardonnez-moi.
units.note: Exact ordered local anchor.

units.source_display:
%S(2,0):Dolt! Serve ME and
 maybe I'll forgive you.
units.android_english_display: %S(2,0): Dolt! Serve ME and maybe I'll forgive you.
units.french_display: %S(2,0) : Pas question ! Si tu veux te faire pardonner, deviens mon esclave !
units.note: SNES PLAYER_NAME(2) + text equals the Android speaker line.

units.source_display:
Otherwise, I'll throw you
 to my servant, %S(0,0).
units.android_english_display: Otherwise, I'll throw you to my servant, %S(0,0).
units.french_display: Si tu n'obéis pas, mon larbin %S(0,0) va te donner une leçon...
units.note: SNES splits the sentence around PLAYER_NAME(0); Android stores one anchor.

units.source_display:
GNOME:Aieee! No!
 Let me be your servant!
units.android_english_display: Gnome: Aieee! No! Let me be your servant!
units.french_display: Gnome : Non ! Pardon ! Je me mettrai à votre service !
units.note: Exact ordered local anchor.

units.source_display:
%S(0,0):HEY! Who're YOU
 calling a servant?
units.android_english_display: %S(0,0): HEY! Who're YOU calling a servant?
units.french_display: %S(0,0) : Hé là ! Qui tu traites de larbin ?
units.note: SNES PLAYER_NAME(0) + text equals the Android speaker line.

units.source_display:
GNOME:Oh dear! Anyway,
 call me anytime, anywhere.
units.android_english_display: Gnome: Oh dear! Anyway, call me anytime, anywhere.
units.french_display: Gnome : Bref, appelez-moi quand vous aurez besoin de moi !
units.note: Exact ordered local anchor.

units.source_display: Now, close your eyes...
units.android_english_display: Now, close your eyes...
units.french_display: Je volerai à votre secours où que vous soyez ! Allez, fermez les yeux, chef !
units.note: Exact ordered local anchor; next Android slot is empty.

units.source_display:
GNOME:Both you and your
 wife may summon me.
units.android_english_display:
Gnome: Both you and your wife may
summon me.
units.french_display: Gnome : Je vous donne ma magie, ainsi qu'à votre dame.
units.note: Exact ordered local anchor after event animation.

units.source_display:
%S(1,0):WHAT?! ME married
 to...THAT?!
units.android_english_display: %S(1,0): WHAT!? ME married to...THAT!?
units.french_display: %S(1,0) : Hein ?! Depuis quand on est mariés ?!
units.note: One Android line spans two SNES text tokens separated by character-action commands.

units.source_display:
%S(2,0):I like your style,
 Gnome!
units.android_english_display: %S(2,0): I like your style, Gnome!
units.french_display: %S(2,0) : Ha ha ! Tu me plais, Gnome !
units.note: SNES PLAYER_NAME(2) + text equals the Android speaker line.

units.source_display:
GNOME:Well, that's that!
 Be seeing you!
units.android_english_display: Gnome: Well, that's that! Be seeing you!
units.french_display: Gnome : Je me retire. À bientôt !
units.note: Exact final anchor of the scene run.

scenes.label: Undine grants magic and the Pole Dart

units.source_display:
UNDINE:Thank you!
 I am Undine.
 My power is your reward.
units.android_english_display: Undine: Thank you! I am Undine, the water elemental. My power is your reward.
units.french_display: Merci ! Je suis Ondine, l'esprit de l'eau. Acceptez ma magie en gage de ma gratitude.
units.note: Same unique Undine introduction; Android expands 'Undine' to 'water elemental'.

units.source_display:
UNDINE:I'll give you 2
 kinds of magic.
units.android_english_display: Undine: I'll give you two kinds of magic.
units.french_display: Nous autres esprits pouvons vous accorder deux types de magie, selon celui qui nous invoque.
units.note: Unique ordered magic-introduction line.

units.source_display:
%S(1,0) can use my recovery
 and defense magic.
units.android_english_display: %S(1,0) can use my recovery and defense magic.
units.french_display: %S(1,0) pourra vous soigner et vous protéger...
units.note: SNES layout token + PLAYER_NAME(1) + continuation form one Android anchor.

units.source_display:
%S(2,0) can use my battle
 magic.
units.android_english_display: %S(2,0) can use my battle magic.
units.french_display: Et %S(2,0) pourra attaquer l'ennemi à l'aide de la puissance de l'eau et de la glace.
units.note: SNES layout token + PLAYER_NAME(2) + continuation form one Android anchor.

units.source_display: %S(0,0):And me?
units.android_english_display: %S(0,0): And me?
units.french_display: %S(0,0) : Et moi ?
units.note: Exact player-name question in ordered run.

units.source_display:
UNDINE:Your Mana Sword will
 one day become more
 powerful than any magic.
units.android_english_display: Undine: Your Mana Sword will one day become more powerful than any magic.
units.french_display: Ondine : Comme tu as retiré l'Épée, tu ne peux plus utiliser la magie.
units.note: Unique Mana Sword explanation anchor.

units.source_display:
You can receive an
 Elemental's power, such as
 Ice Saber, on your sword!
units.android_english_display: You can receive an elemental's power, such as Ice Saber, on your sword!
units.french_display: Si tu essayais, cette dernière entrerait en conflit avec l'énergie de l'Épée, et tu pourrais en mourir.
units.note: Unique Ice Saber explanation anchor; French localization rewrites the explanation.

units.source_display:
%S(1,0) can cast Ice Saber
 on your weapon to turn
 enemies into snowmen!
units.android_english_display: %S(1,0) can cast Ice Saber on your weapon to turn enemies into snowmen!
units.french_display: Tu peux cependant bénéficier des sorts que %S(1,0) lancera sur ton arme, comme la Lame de glace. Une arme investie de ce pouvoir gèle celui qu'elle frappe et le change en bonhomme de neige !
units.note: Android English anchor 965 is followed by empty 966, which French uses to continue the localized explanation.

units.source_display:
And this! Take this with
 you. It is one of the Mana
 weapons.
units.android_english_display: And this! Take this with you. It is one of the Mana weapons.
units.french_display: Je vous offre aussi cette arme. Elle vous permettra d'atteindre les ennemis qui se trouvent en hauteur ou en contrebas.
units.note: Unique weapon-gift line.

units.source_display: Received Pole Dart!
units.android_english_display: Received Pole Dart!
units.french_display: Vous obtenez le Javelot !
units.note: Exact item-receipt text; preceding SNES newline/TEXT_X are layout commands, not semantic prose.

units.source_display: UNDINE:Call me anytime!
units.android_english_display: Undine: Call me anytime!
units.french_display: N'hésitez pas à faire appel à moi si je peux vous aider.
units.note: Unique Undine farewell anchor.

units.source_display: Gained Undine's powers!
units.android_english_display: Gained Undine's powers!
units.french_display: Vous obtenez les pouvoirs d'Ondine !
units.note: Exact power-acquisition notification; preceding SNES newline is layout-only.

units.source_display:
%S(2,0):No one can stop
 ME now!
units.android_english_display: %S(2,0): No one can stop ME now!
units.french_display: %S(2,0) : Hé hé hé ! J'suis un sorcier, maintenant !
units.note: Exact player-name boast at the end of the scene.

scenes.label: Emperor trap and Sheex / Dark Stalker reveal

units.source_display:
EMPEROR:So glad to see you!
 You're going to like this.
units.android_english_display: Emperor: So glad to see you! You're going to like this.
units.french_display: Empereur : Ha ha ha... tout droit dans la gueule du loup. Je ne vous laisserai pas me mettre des bâtons dans les roues, cette fois !
units.note: Unique Emperor opening line.

units.source_display:
The ancient continent will
 surface once I've broken
 all the palace seals.
units.android_english_display: The ancient continent will surface once I've broken all the palace seals.
units.french_display: Une fois les huit sceaux brisés, le continent ancien va refaire surface !
units.note: Exact ordered ancient-continent line.

units.source_display:
Once I break this last
 seal, the Mana Fortress
 will rise!
units.android_english_display: Once I break this last seal, the Mana Fortress will rise!
units.french_display: Il ne reste plus que ce sceau... ensuite, la Forteresse de Mana s'élèvera de nouveau !
units.note: Exact ordered Mana Fortress line.

units.source_display:
Too bad you won't be
 around!
units.android_english_display: Too bad you won't be around!_
units.french_display: Malheureusement, vous ne serez plus là pour y assister... Ha ha ha._
units.note: Exact ordered threat; Android underscore is a presentation marker.

units.source_display: Who wants the job?
units.android_english_display: Who wants the job?
units.french_display: Qui veut commencer ?
units.note: Exact short question in the same ordered run.

units.source_display:
SHEEX:I owe them one
 since the Republic!
 Leave it to me!
units.android_english_display: Sheex: I've owed them one since the republic! Leave it to me!
units.french_display: Sheek : Votre Majesté, laissez-moi m'en charger. Partez en avant avec Faunach, et retrouvons-nous à l'autel.  Sheek : J'ai enfin ma chance de me venger de l'humiliation de Tasmanica !
units.note: English 2687-2688 are empty localization slots; French uses 2688 for extra Sheex detail.

units.source_display:
%S(0,0):You?
 You're the Dark Stalker?!
units.android_english_display: %S(0,0): You? You're the Dark Stalker!?
units.french_display: %S(0,0) : C'était vous, l'assassin noir qui a tenté de tuer le roi ?
units.note: Exact player-name Dark Stalker reveal.

units.source_display:
SHEEX:Behold! Have a taste
 of my true power!
units.android_english_display: Sheex: Behold! Have a taste of my true power!
units.french_display: Sheek : Oui ! Mais quand je me serai transformé, vous ne ferez pas le poids contre moi !
units.note: Exact Sheex transformation challenge.

units.source_display:
SHEEX:Ha! The underworld
 gives us its strength.
 I'll squash you!
units.android_english_display: Sheex: Ha! The underworld gives us its strength. I'll squash you!
units.french_display: Sheek : Mouahaha ! Des gamins comme vous ne pourront jamais battre la puissance des forces du mal !  %S(0,0) : Quoi ? Mais alors... vos pouvoirs... L'Empereur a réellement... ?!
units.note: Post-battle scene resumes at Android 2723; empty English 2724 carries extra French reaction text.

units.source_display:
SHEEX:The contract we signed with the underworld gives
 us control of THIS world!
units.android_english_display: Sheex: The contract we signed with the underworld gives us control of THIS world!
units.french_display: Sheek : Oui... Nous avons conclu un pacte avec les forces maléfiques, pour régner sur le monde !
units.note: Unique underworld-contract line after the Android-ID jump.

units.source_display:
To keep humans under my
 control, we're reviving
 the Mana Fortress!
units.android_english_display: To keep humans under our control, we're reviving the Mana Fortress!
units.french_display: Et maintenant, nous allons rétablir la Forteresse de Mana, et plus personne ne pourra se dresser sur notre chemin !
units.note: Same Mana Fortress motive; minor pronoun wording difference does not affect identity.

units.source_display: Now your time is over...
units.android_english_display: Now your time is over...
units.french_display: Préparez-vous à mourir !
units.note: Exact final threat of the ordered scene run.
